children.title: Little Souls Path
children.description: A joyful, story-based introduction to Jain values for ages 3-8. Through animal stories, gentle lessons, and playful activities, children discover the beauty of Ahimsa, truth, and kindness.

modules.title: The Magic of Namokar Mantra
modules.description: Learn the Navkar Mantra through song and play. Discover that praying means sending love to all beings.
activities: Chant the mantra with hand gestures

modules.title: Ahimsa — The Superpower of Non-Violence
modules.description: Understand that Ahimsa means not hurting anyone with hands, words, or thoughts. Learn to be a superhero of kindness.
activities: Say sorry when you hurt someone's feelings
resources: Story: The Cobra and the Monk

modules.title: Tirthankara Tales for Tiny Hearts
modules.description: Stories of the 24 great teachers, simplified for young minds. Meet Mahavira, Parshvanath, and others through colorful narratives.
activities: Meditation on one Tirthankara per week

modules.title: First Steps in Fasting
modules.description: Age-appropriate fasting practices: skipping candy, eating simple food, and understanding self-control as a strength.
activities: Eat simple food (one dish) on festival days
Give one toy to someone who has none

youth.title: Young Explorers Path
youth.description: For ages 9-13 exploring Jain philosophy actively. Interactive lessons on Tattvas, Karma theory basics, and building a Jain identity in school and social media.

modules.title: Jain Universe 101
modules.description: Explore Jain cosmology: Jambudvipa, upper worlds, lower worlds, and Siddhashila. Understand where our soul fits in the cosmos.
activities: Map the 14 Gunasthanaks on a ladder
Write a diary entry from a soul's journey

modules.title: Karma Lab — Science of Action
modules.description: Discover how action, thought, and intention create karma. Understand Bandha, Samvara, and Nirjara as spiritual technology.
activities: Karma journal: track 5 good and 5 harmful actions
Role-play different kashayas (anger, pride, deceit, greed)

modules.title: Agama Expedition
modules.description: A guided tour of Jain scriptures. Learn about the 12 Angas, 12 Upangas, and post-canonical works. Find out which texts contain what wisdom.
activities: Create a comic strip of Bhagavati Sutra Q&A
Visit a temple library and photograph ancient texts

modules.title: Digital Dharma — Jainism in Modern Life
modules.description: How to be a Jain in the age of social media, competitive sports, vegan cafes, and climate activism. Practical applications of ancient values.
activities: Create an Ahimsa social media campaign
Volunteer at an animal shelter for 4 hours

adult.title: Deep Study Path
adult.description: For adults seeking serious philosophical grounding. Includes systematic study of Tattvartha Sutra, Karma theory, Gunasthanaks, and comparative religion.

modules.title: Tattvartha Sutra — The Universal Manual
modules.description: A deep verse-by-verse study of Umaswati's Tattvartha Sutra (357 sutras, 10 chapters). The definitive summary of all Jain philosophy.
activities: Compare with Buddhist and Hindu parallels

modules.title: Advanced Karma Theory
modules.description: Detailed study of 148 karma subtypes, bondage mechanisms, duration, intensity, and the path to complete Nirjara. Includes works of Nemichandra and Devendrasuri.

modules.title: Gunasthanak — The 14 Stages
modules.description: An experiential study of each of the 14 stages, identifying where you currently stand and plotting a path forward.
activities: Meditate on the qualities of each stage

householder.title: Householder Dharma Path
householder.description: For married Jains balancing family, career, and spiritual life. Practical guidance for integrating Jain ethics into modern marriage, parenting, business, and community leadership.

modules.title: 12 Shravaka Vows — Ethics in Action
modules.description: A complete study of the 12 vows for householders: 5 Anuvratas, 3 Gunavratas, and 4 Shikshavratas. Practical application to modern life.
activities: Pick one vow to deepen this month

modules.title: Jain Parenting — Raising Compassionate Children
modules.description: How to raise children with Ahimsa, non-violence, and spiritual values in a competitive world. From toddlers to teenagers.

modules.title: Jain Business Ethics
modules.description: How to run a business with integrity, avoiding harm in supply chains, treating employees fairly, and donating consciously.
activities: Audit your supply chain for Ahimsa compliance
Set up a family charity fund
Volunteer professional skills to the Sangha
Host a Jain business ethics dinner

modules.title: Daily Rhythm — Samayika to Sleep
modules.description: Building a complete daily schedule: morning Samayika, work with mindfulness, evening Pratikramana, and night contemplation. Making Jain practice sustainable long-term.
activities: Set phone reminders for spiritual moments

monastic.title: Monastic Path
monastic.description: For those considering or committed to monastic life. The 28 Mulagunas, 5 Mahavratas, 5 Samitis, 3 Guptis, and 11 Pratimas systematically explained.

modules.title: The 5 Mahavratas in Daily Practice
modules.description: Deep reflection on each Mahavrata: total Ahimsa, Satya, Achaurya, Brahmacharya, Aparigraha. How they manifest in every action, word, and thought.

modules.title: Kayotsarga — The Art of Stillness
modules.description: Mastering the posture of complete physical abandonment while maintaining highest mental alertness.

scholar.title: Scholar Path
scholar.description: For academics, researchers, and advanced students pursuing original scholarship in Jain studies. Covers Prakrit, Sanskrit, manuscripts, historiography, and comparative religion.

modules.title: Prakrit and Sanskrit for Jain Texts
modules.description: Learn to read original Agamas in Ardhamagadhi Prakrit and classical Sanskrit. Understand grammar, meter, and Buddhist parallels.
activities: Translate 1 sutra daily from Tattvartha Sutra

modules.title: Manuscriptology and Textual Criticism
modules.description: Study palm-leaf manuscripts, palaeography, colophons, and the methodologies of recovering canonical texts.
activities: Visit Jain Bhandars in Patan, Jaisalmer, Khambhat
Learn to read Modi and Devanagari scripts

diaspora.title: Diaspora Guide
diaspora.description: For Jains living outside India. Practical strategies for maintaining Jain values in Western life: finding temples, raising children, celebrating festivals, vegetarian challenges, and interfaith family dynamics.

modules.title: Finding Your Jain Community Abroad
modules.description: How to locate Jain centers, connect with local sanghas, and build community from scratch when none exists nearby.

modules.title: Jain Parenting in Western Schools
modules.description: Vegetarian lunch politics, explaining Diwali to classmates, dress code for temple with fashion-forward teens, and navigating Jainism alongside other religions.
activities: Create a 'Jain 101' presentation for your child's class
Start a Jain club at school
Volunteer at local food bank as a family
Celebrate Paryushan with a small home Puja

modules.title: Ethical Consumerism — Jain Values in Supermarkets
modules.description: Navigating modern consumer culture with Jain ethics: vegan vs vegetarian debates, microplastics, palm oil, fast fashion, and technology ethics.
activities: Audit your shopping cart for Ahimsa compliance
